d: Qiddiya is seeking an experienced security leader to lead frontline security operations across Qiddiya City. Reporting to the Executive Director, Security Operations, you will bring together general security, vehicle checkpoints and screening, mobile patrols, and event mobilisation into one coordinated operating model.
You will translate security strategy into safe, effective and guest-aware operations, leading internal teams and contracted service providers across a complex, city-scale environment.
q: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent recognised qualification in security, risk, emergency management, operations, business or a related discipline.
Typically 15+ years of security operations experience , including substantial senior leadership responsibility for large, complex and contracted frontline services.
Proven experience leading multiple security service lines across complex, multi-site or city-scale environments.
Experience managing senior managers and substantial internal and contracted workforces.
Demonstrated experience in major incidents, large events, mobilisation, asset openings and service recovery.
Strong experience in contractor performance, staffing governance, budgets, KPIs and executive reporting.
CPP, CSMP or an equivalent senior security certification.
Qualifications in incident command, emergency management, contract management, project management or business continuity.
Experience in Saudi Arabia, the GCC, major destinations, critical infrastructure, public realm or giga-project environments.
Incident leadership, operational readiness and resilience.
Executive communication, stakeholder engagement and evidence-based decision-making.
r: Lead frontline security delivery across static guarding, access control, vehicle screening, mobile patrols, rapid response and event mobilisation.
Lead senior managers and operational teams, establishing clear priorities, deployment plans, service standards and accountability.
Oversee security contractors, ensuring appropriate staffing, licensing, competence, supervision and performance against agreed KPIs.
Direct field-resource coordination during significant incidents, service disruptions and major events through the approved command structure.
Lead security readiness for new assets, city activations and events, ensuring personnel, equipment, procedures and response arrangements are in place.
Manage operational risks, budgets and resources, providing clear executive reporting on performance, readiness and decisions required.
Collaborate with command and control, training and assurance teams, asset operators and relevant stakeholders to strengthen operational delivery and embed lessons learned.

Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.
